meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档变成可爱的幻灯片 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把文档快速变成可分享的叙事幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute slide-deck PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly turn a document into shareable narrative slides

howto.what: 把一份文档变成可爱卡通风格的幻灯片 PDF,并给出手机版分享链接。若文档缺失或太单薄,会先补写文档再生成,完成后展示分享链接和本地 PDF。
howto.when: 当你说“Wowerpoint 某个文件”“把这个做成幻灯片”“把这份报告转成幻灯片”等时触发。

say.text: 用 wowerpoint 把这份报告做成幻灯片
say.note: 会生成 PDF 和手机分享链接

say.text: 给这份文档做个可爱风格演示文稿
say.note: 会用 kawaii 角色讲故事

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii slide-deck PDF and produces a mobile share link. If the source is missing or too thin, it writes the document first, then generates the deck.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like "Wowerpoint <file>", "Make a slide deck about <file>", "Turn this report into slides", etc.

say_en.text: Make a wowerpoint deck from this report
say_en.note: Produces a PDF and a share link

say_en.text: Turn this document into a kawaii deck
say_en.note: Uses kawaii characters to tell the story
Uses the named file as source
